purpose: 영어 초록 문장에 대한 확신/완화(certainty/hedging) 단서 사전. Notion 계획 ⑥ '영어 원문 교차 확인'용. 문장별로 Sumner et al. 2014 (BMJ) 7단계 인과 주장 강도(0-6)를 부여하고, 이를 한국어 사전과 같은 단정/가능성/연관/무관 4범주로 접어서(collapsed_ko) 번역문의 한국어 사전 라벨과 일치율을 계산한다. 규칙 평가는 대소문자 무시(re.IGNORECASE)로 수행한다.

status_values.verified_lecture_pdf: 첨부된 수업 PDF(W5_1_Text_Preprocessing_2.pdf)에서 본문 그대로 확인한 항목. 페이지 번호는 pdftotext 기준.
status_values.unverified_from_memory: 인용 출처에 있다고 기억하지만 컨테이너에 네트워크가 없어 원문(본문·부록·보충자료)과 대조하지 못한 항목. 네트워크가 열리면 docs/certainty_lexicon_source.md의 검증 목록대로 확인해야 한다.
status_values.project_addition: 어떤 출처에도 근거하지 않고 이 프로젝트(코퍼스: 세마글루타이드 부작용 초록)를 위해 추가한 항목. 휴리스틱이므로 결과 보고 시 반드시 명시하고, 가능하면 사람 검증으로 확인한다.

provenance_policy.network_note: 작성 시점(2026-10-30) 컨테이너에서 Europe PMC, PubMed, Crossref, 출판사 사이트 접근이 차단되어 어떤 학술 출처도 원문 확인을 하지 못했다. 따라서 수업 PDF 외의 모든 source 항목은 unverified_from_memory다.
provenance_policy.matching: pattern은 Python re 모듈용 정규식이며 모두 \b 단어 경계를 쓴다. re.IGNORECASE 플래그로 컴파일할 것(사전 자체는 소문자로 적되 약어 HR/OR/RR/CI는 원문 대문자 표기를 그대로 둔다). W5 수업의 TOKEN_PATTERN은 숫자와 축약형을 보존하므로, 단서 매칭은 토큰화 전의 원문 문장(casefold만 적용)에 대해 수행한다.

sources.citation: Sumner P, Vivian-Griffiths S, Boivin J, Williams A, Venetis CA, Davies A, Ogden J, Whelan L, Hughes B, Dalton B, Boy F, Chambers CD. The association between exaggeration in health related science news and academic press releases: retrospective observational study. BMJ 2014;349:g7015. doi:10.1136/bmj.g7015
sources.what_used: 7-level causal-claim strength scale (0 no statement, 1 statement of no relationship, 2 correlational/associational statement, 3 ambiguous statement of relationship, 4 conditional statement of causation, 5 statement of 'can' cause, 6 unconditional statement of causation) and its example phrases; the rule that a text is coded by its strongest (highest) claim. The scale is in the paper's Box/Table and the full coding scheme with phrase lists is in the web appendix (supplementary coding scheme).
sources.verify_against: BMJ 2014;349:g7015 web appendix (supplementary coding scheme) — the exact phrase-to-level table.

sources.citation: Hyland K. Metadiscourse: Exploring Interaction in Writing. London: Continuum, 2005. (Appendix: list of metadiscourse items — hedges and boosters)
sources.what_used: hedge word list and booster word list (interactional metadiscourse). Hyland's hedges mark the writer's reluctance to present a proposition categorically; boosters mark certainty.
sources.verify_against: Hyland 2005 Appendix (the same lists are reprinted in Hyland 1998 'Hedging in Scientific Research Articles' and Hyland 2005 Discourse Studies 7(2):173-192).

sources.citation: Adams RC, Sumner P, Vivian-Griffiths S, Barrington A, Williams A, Boivin J, Chambers CD, Bott L. How readers understand causal and correlational expressions used in news headlines. J Exp Psychol Appl 2017;23(1):1-14. doi:10.1037/xap0000100
sources.what_used: correlational vs 'can'/conditional vs direct-causal phrase examples used as stimuli (e.g. 'associated with', 'linked to', 'related to' vs 'might cause', 'can increase' vs 'causes', 'increases', 'leads to').
sources.verify_against: Adams et al. 2017 Table 1 / supplementary stimulus list.

sources.citation: Vincze V, Szarvas G, Farkas R, Móra G, Csirik J. The BioScope corpus: biomedical texts annotated for uncertainty, negation and their scopes. BMC Bioinformatics 2008;9(Suppl 11):S9. doi:10.1186/1471-2105-9-S11-S9
sources.what_used: Biomedical hedge (speculation) cue examples from the annotation guidelines (e.g. may, might, could, possible, possibly, likely, suggest, indicate, appear, seem, whether, putative, potential, hypothesis) and negation cue examples (no, not, without, absence, fail to, lack). Used only to corroborate cues that are not in Hyland 2005 and to anchor the negation-cue list; the BioScope guideline treats the scope of a cue linguistically, not with a token window.
sources.verify_against: BioScope annotation guidelines (supplementary file) and Farkas R et al. CoNLL-2010 Shared Task: Learning to detect hedges and their scope in natural language text.

sources.citation: 수업 자료 W5_1_Text_Preprocessing_2.pdf (첨부 파일), p.14 regex tokenizer, p.27-33 advanced preprocessing

sources.citation: 팀 Notion '계획 v2' (영어 초록 전처리 제안 ⑥, 한국어 사전 규칙 ⑤ '단서가 여럿이면 가장 강한 것으로')
sources.what_used: the collapse of the 7-level scale to 단정/가능성/연관·무관 and the 'strongest cue wins' sentence rule.

6.example_en: X causes Y / X increases the risk of Y / X leads to Y

5.example_en: X can cause Y / X can increase the risk of Y

4.example_en: X may cause Y / X might increase Y / X could lead to Y

3.example_en: the effect/impact of X on Y / X affects Y / X influences Y
3.note: Sumner 2014는 effect/impact/affect/influence처럼 인과를 암시하지만 명시하지 않는 표현을 3(ambiguous)으로 둔 것으로 기억한다. 원문 보충자료로 확인 필요.

2.example_en: X is associated with Y / X is linked to Y / patients taking X had a higher risk of Y

1.example_en: X was not associated with Y / no increased risk of Y with X

0.example_en: (sentence describes methods, sample size, setting, etc.)

sentence_rule.description: 1) Run all `entries` patterns (re.IGNORECASE) on the sentence (casefold/NFKC-normalised, numbers kept, contractions normalised per W5 p.33). 2) Base level = highest level among matched entries (Sumner 2014 codes a text by its strongest claim; Notion 계획 v2 ⑤ '단서가 여럿이면 가장 강한 것으로'). 3) 'associated with (an) increased risk' must resolve to level 2, not 6: the level-6 'increase the risk' pattern excludes the participial form after a determiner/preposition by lookbehind, so no extra precedence logic is needed; verify on the 번역 검수 sheet. 4) Modifiers: if base level == 6 and `can` matches -> 5; if base level >= 5 and may/might/could (or the project adjectival hedges) match -> 4. 5) Negation: if a no_relationship_cues pattern matched -> level 1 regardless of other cues; else if a negation cue occurs within `negation_window_tokens` tokens BEFORE a level>=2 cue -> level 1. 6) If no entry matched -> level 0. 7) collapsed_ko = collapse_map.level_to_collapsed[level]. 8) hedges/boosters do not change the level; they are counted separately (hedge_count, booster_count) and listed in the 번역 검수 sheet (Notion ⑤) so every sentence with a cue is reviewed against the source.
sentence_rule.source: sumner2014 (highest claim; may/might/could=4; can=5; no relationship=1) + notion_plan_v2 ⑤ + w5_lecture p.30-33 (keep negations, contraction normalisation)

status.participial_exclusion_step3: project_addition — the determiner/preposition lookbehind list is a project pattern
status.negation_window_tokens: project_addition — PROJECT HEURISTIC (Sumner codes the whole statement by hand; BioScope resolves negation scope syntactically, not by a fixed window). Report it explicitly and check with human validation.

sentence_rule.negation_window_direction: before the cue (negation precedes the relationship word in English: 'was not associated', 'no increased risk', 'did not increase')
sentence_rule.tokenizer_for_window: W5 lecture p.14 TOKEN_PATTERN = [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)+|[A-Za-z]+|\d+(?:\.\d+)? applied after NFKC+casefold; numbers kept (Notion ⑧).

agreement_evaluation.description: For Notion ⑥: compare collapsed_ko of each English source sentence with the Korean-lexicon label of its translation (same sentence_id). Report simple agreement rate and Cohen's kappa; disagreement rows go to the 번역 검수 sheet.
